decision: The RD23 artifact is tracked and hash-bound but cannot serve as the frozen FULL_EXISTING_NATIVE_MATRIX_AS_STUDY_STRATA input: its producer emits six raw-edge families, lacks atr24_at_signal, and does not implement the current union/standalone constructor contract. Its raw-root selector is also not pre-open certified because the physical 1H row groups cross the protected-year boundary.
exact_remaining_authority_gaps: A current-nine-strata-compatible immutable pre-2023 signal artifact is absent.
No physically pre-2023-isolated upstream 1H source or authorized source date selector is bound for lawful materialization.
